timezone.title: Timezone

Locale.title: Locale

UserRole.title: UserRole

bearerAuth.description: Opaque access token issued by POST /auth/login. Token hash is stored server-side in auth_sessions and can be revoked immediately.

post.description: Authenticate with email/password; returns access token, refresh session, user, locale and theme. Failure must not distinguish unknown user from wrong password (both UNAUTHENTICATED).

get.description: Return the ActorContext injected from the Authorization header.

post.description: Rotate access and refresh tokens. The previous tokens are invalidated immediately in the same transaction.

401.description: Refresh token expired, revoked or user deactivated.

post.description: Atomically create Project, immutable template/session snapshot, DISPATCH_PENDING weather Task and WeatherFetchRequested OutboxEvent in a single MySQL transaction. Idempotent by (actorId, Idempotency-Key). Response returns the same weatherTaskId on first create (201) and replay (200).

parameters.description: Client-generated printable ASCII key; unique within actor scope. Not part of canonical request hash.
parameters.name: Idempotency-Key

200.description: Idempotent replay returns the original aggregate

403.description: Role is neither ENGINEER nor ADMIN.

404.description: templateVersionId does not exist or is not visible; indistinguishable from random unknown id.

409.description: Idempotency-Key already bound to a different canonical request.

503.description: Pre-commit deterministic failure; safe to retry with the same key.

get.description: List tasks scoped to the actor (ENGINEER sees own; ADMIN sees all).

403.description: Cross-owner access is denied for ENGINEER.

get.description: Return a single task. Cross-owner existing id and random unknown id must return indistinguishable 404 (anti-enumeration).

403.description: Within caller scope but role lacks read permission.

404.description: Task not visible to caller or does not exist; indistinguishable.
